name: Dephaser JPY
oneLiner: JPYT is DePhaser's yen stablecoin, minted by locking USDT on Optimism or USDC on Base against a yen FX oracle, with collateral returned on redemption.
collateral: USDT locked on Optimism and USDC locked on Base through the DePhaser platform to mint JPYT
pegMechanism: Users lock USDT on Optimism or USDC on Base to mint JPYT against a real-time yen exchange-rate oracle; the redemption flow permits/burns JPYT and returns the selected USDT or USDC collateral to the user

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Dilutable review: the verified JPYT source exposes MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE, with mint(address,uint256) gated by MINTER_ROLE and role administration held by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. No holder freeze or blacklist function was identified in the reviewed token source.
